description: The Hotline TURTLE is a compact and reliable dual SIM feature phone designed for everyday communication. With its 1.8-inch display, easy-to-use keypad, and lightweight design, it is perfect for basic calling and messaging needs. Stay entertained with built-in wireless FM radio and multimedia support including MP3, MP4, and 3GP formats. The digital camera allows you to capture moments, while expandable memory support gives you extra storage flexibility. The phone also includes a powerful LED torch, vibration alert, and long-lasting battery backup, making it ideal for daily use, travel, or as a backup phone. Proudly Made in India, the Hotline V66 is simple, durable, and user-friendly.
